scene mayahallmayahall1
When she opens the door, she falls into a pit. And after a lengthy battle with quicksand, she emerges in the halls of a familiar place.
lines.zh: 当她推开门，便坠入了一个深坑。在与流沙漫长地缠斗过后，她出现在一处熟悉之地的走廊里。

lines.en: Never at night, though. There was no reason to come here once the sun settled into its resting place — signaling to its brother “Moon” that it was time for a shift change.
lines.zh: 但绝不是夜里。一旦太阳落入它的安息之所——向它的兄弟「月亮」发出换班的信号——就再没有理由来这儿了。

lines.en: A bell goes off, but there is no imposing disclosing of an encroaching symposium — just radio silence and white noise so quiet it still meets the criteria of “nothingness.”
lines.zh: 铃声响起，却没有任何一场即将降临的讨论会那咄咄逼人的开场宣告——只有无线电静默，以及安静得仍符合「虚无」标准的白噪音。

lines.en: Cold air blows in through the windows, each one with invisible cracks left by malicious glassmakers tired of teenage girls walking all over their hard work in exchange for temporary poignancy and pleasure.
lines.zh: 冷风从每扇窗灌进来，每扇窗上都留着一道道看不见的裂痕，那是恶意的玻璃工匠留下的——他们受够了少女们踩着他们的心血走来走去，只为换取片刻的感伤与欢愉。

lines.en: She can hear cracking noises slipping out from where her loafers meet the linoleum, but she’s too busy wondering how she got here to waste her worries on suspicious, misplaced foley.
lines.zh: 她能听见鞋底与油毡地相接处漏出的咯吱声，可她太忙于琢磨自己怎么到这儿来的，没工夫为这可疑的、错位的拟音浪费忧虑。

lines.en: It’s because of this that she doesn’t hear the footsteps behind her, keeping in time with hers as she leads someone somewhere.
lines.zh: 正因如此，她才没听见身后的脚步声——那脚步与她的步频一致，仿佛她正领着某个人去往某处。

lines.en: They stop soon-after, waiting for the girl to progress. But how can such a thing even happen when each blink takes her backwards? When each step shakes more quicksand out of her shoes.
lines.zh: 它们很快停了下来，等着女孩继续往前。可这样的事怎么可能发生呢？每当她眨眼，就被带回身后；每迈一步，鞋里就抖落出更多流沙。

lines.en: It’s okay, though! You can make glass out of {i}that{/i} too! You can make glass out of anything these days! Which might explain why we all feel so fragile — how we can crack if someone looks at us the wrong way.
lines.zh: 不过没关系！{i}那{/i}些也能拿来做成玻璃！这年头什么都能拿来做玻璃！这或许就解释了为什么我们都觉得自己如此易碎——为什么别人一个眼神不对，我们就会裂开。

lines.en: We can crack when no one looks at us too, though.
lines.zh: 不过，就算没人看我们，我们也会裂开。

lines.en: Every step is a risk. Every thought is a risk. But just {i}waiting{/i} is a risk! So all you can really do is sprint as fast as you can so no one tries to steal your pieces to make up for the gaps they’ve put in themselves.
lines.zh: 每一步都是风险。每一个念头都是风险。可光是{i}等待{/i}也是风险！所以你真正能做的，就是拼尽全力狂奔，别让任何人偷走你的碎片，去填补他们自己身上的缺口。

lines.en: : Um...Maya?
lines.zh: ：唔……Maya？

lines.en: scene mayahallmayahall2
: Huh?!
It’s then that she finally notices the creature trailing her — more dangerous, yet somehow more fuckable than an adult black bear. But would he be willing to stay awake through the winter for her?
lines.zh: 这时她才终于注意到尾随她的那个东西——比起成年黑熊更危险，却又不知怎地更值得上一发。可他会愿意为她熬过整个冬天不冬眠吗？

lines.en: : You just...stopped. I don’t know what you want me to do with these.
lines.zh: ：你刚刚……停下来了。我不知道你想让我拿这些东西怎么办。

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: ：Sensei？……

lines.en: : Uh...yes?
scene mayahallmayahall3
: I don’t...really...uhh...

lines.en: : Where...

lines.zh: ：你看见……Ami走过去了吗？……我想我……应该是在找她……

lines.en: : Uhh...no?
lines.zh: ：呃……没有？

lines.en: : I kind of just assumed she was in your room, but I never got a chance to check since you shoved these boxes into my arms the second I showed up there.
lines.zh: ：我以为她就在你房间，可我根本没机会确认——我一到那儿，你就把这几箱东西塞进我怀里了。

lines.en: scene mayahallmayahall4
: R-Right! Yeah!
lines.zh: ：对——对！没错！

lines.en: : Listen, I’m...I’m sorry for freaking out earlier. It’s just...you know, you’ve been so distant lately and...ugh...it’s going to sound annoyingly sappy but, like...I can feel you sort of...slipping away.
lines.zh: ：听着，我……我为刚才那通发作道歉。只是……你知道的，你最近一直这么疏远，而且……呃……听起来会很腻人，可就是……我能感觉到你好像在……一点点溜走。

lines.en: : Y-You don’t have to say anything back! I just...figured I should maybe explain myself since I stormed out on a bad note and...
lines.zh: ：你、你不用回答我！我只是……想着我该解释一下，毕竟我甩门走的时候气氛那么糟，而且……

lines.en: : If there’s anything I can do to keep you with me, just tell me. I really {i}am{/i} ready to talk about this...{i}alternate Maya{/i} or whatever it is you guys all seem to be hung up on.
lines.zh: ：如果有任何事能让我留住你，直接告诉我。我{i}真的{/i}准备好聊那个……{i}另一个 Maya{/i} 之类的事了，不管你们到底在纠结什么。

lines.zh: ：Maya，冷静点。我没有为了任何人「甩掉你」。

: Oh! R...Right. {i}That{/i} takoyaki stand. How could I forget?
lines.zh: ：哦！对……对。{i}那{/i}家章鱼烧摊。我怎么会忘。

lines.en: : Beats me. That seems like the only place you ever want to eat nowadays. But if you’d rather just walk around town or head back to my place instead, that’s fine by me.
lines.zh: ：我哪知道。这年头你好像只想去那儿吃。不过你要是更想随便逛逛镇子，或者回我那儿，我也没意见。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m...not that hungry right now anyway...

lines.en: : Okay. I was curious before, but now I {i}know{/i} something is wrong.

lines.en: scene mayahallmayahall13
: {i}Why?{/i} Because it’ll make me sound fucking insane! That’s why. I have no idea what’s happening to me right now.
lines.zh: ：{i}为什么？{/i}因为说出来会让我显得他妈的像个疯子！就因为这个。我完全不知道我现在到底怎么了。

lines.en: : Well, why not try explaining it then? Tons of crazy stuff has happened to us. It’ll take a lot more than being unaware of your surroundings to make me think you’re {i}insane,{/i} Maya.
lines.zh: ：那不如试着解释一下？我们身上发生过一堆疯事。光是没注意到周围环境，还不足以让我觉得你{i}疯{/i}了，Maya。

lines.en: : Okay, sure. But how about being in like three different timelines at once? How does {i}that{/i} make me sound?
lines.zh: ：好吧，行。{i}那{/i}同时待在三个不同的时间线里呢？这听起来像什么？

lines.en: : Kind of insane, yeah.

lines.en: : It’s {i}fine,{/i} though. That’s nothing compared to what I’ve put {i}you{/i} through, I’m sure. The least I can do is try and keep you grounded for a minute, right?
lines.zh: ：不过{i}没关系{/i}。跟我让{i}你{/i}经历的那些比起来，这不算什么，我敢肯定。我至少能做的，就是先让你稳住一会儿，对吧？

lines.en: scene mayahallmayahall15
: Maybe more than a minute if that’s okay. Because you {i}do{/i} put me through a lot. And being with you like this again is probably all I need to start feeling, like...{i}okay.{/i}
lines.zh: ：如果可以的话，也许不止一会儿。因为你{i}确实{/i}让我经历了很多。而能像这样再次和你在一起，大概就是让我重新感觉……{i}好起来{/i}所需要的全部了。

: Because it {i}has{/i} been lately! I keep having to come to you! And it’s been super exhausting and upsetting because it makes me feel like you’re getting bored of me!
lines.zh: ：因为最近{i}就是{/i}这样啊！我一直得主动来找你！而这超级累人、超级难受，因为这让我觉得你开始对我腻了！

lines.en: : Oh, shut up. You’ve barely grown at all since we met. But I doubt my feelings will change even when we’re old. That’s why I promised to be with you forever.
lines.zh: ：哦，闭嘴。从我们认识起你几乎就没长过。但就算我们都老了，我也不觉得我的感觉会变。所以我才答应永远和你在一起。

lines.en: With how frequent and drastic Maya’s leaps through time had become, there was no way of discerning whether or not this was a memory, the future, or even a dream!
lines.zh: 以 Maya 时间跳跃变得如此频繁而剧烈的程度，根本无法分辨这究竟是一段记忆、未来，还是一场梦！

lines.en: That didn’t matter to her right now, though. All that mattered were indulging in these feelings as she had no way of knowing if she’d ever {i}feel{/i} them again if she {i}did{/i} return to where she was meant to be.
lines.zh: 不过此刻这对她并不重要。重要的只是沉溺于这些{i}感觉{/i}之中——因为她无从知晓，若自己{i}真{/i}回到本该在的地方，是否还能再次感受到它们。

lines.en: She reaches down and grabs his wrist in an attempt to bring him even closer.
lines.zh: 她伸手向下，抓住他的手腕，想把他拉得更近。

lines.en: He resists at first, only to frustrate her more. But she wins in the end. She always does. She always did.
lines.zh: 他起初抗拒，只让她更加烦躁。但最终她赢了。她总是赢。她一直都赢。

lines.en: And within a matter of seconds, her fingers are curled around his hand as he uses {i}his{/i} fingers to slide her panties to the side.
